description: This PHP class `DataRegistrationUtility` is part of the OrangeHRM project and handles registration data management, including initializing registration information, setting instance identifiers, and sending registration data upon success. It interacts with configuration and system components to facilitate the registration process during installation or upgrade.

classes.name: DataRegistrationUtility
classes.description: Handles registration data collection, identifier setup, and communication with registration services during the installation or upgrade processes.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Collects initial registration data from system configuration and generates an instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstallerInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves registration data specific to the installer session from the StateContainer singleton.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Generates registration data payload based on whether it's an install or upgrade, preparing data for server submission.

methods.name: getSuccessRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Creates the payload to be sent upon successful registration indicating registration success.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Sets a unique instance identifier if not already set, based on configuration and server host.

methods.name: sendRegistrationDataOnSuccess
methods.description: Sends registration success data to external service and logs the event in system configuration.
